parameters.query:
WITH base_filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id,
    p.loja_id,
    l.nome AS loja_nome,
    p.nome,
    p.whatsapp,
    p.picture_url,
    p.status,
    p.origem,
    p.ultimo_criativo_id,
    cr.titulo AS ultimo_criativo_titulo,
    cr.tema AS ultimo_criativo_tema,
    cr.ad_id AS ultimo_criativo_ad_id,
    cr.canal AS ultimo_criativo_canal,
    cr.media_url AS ultimo_criativo_media_url,
    cr.source_url AS ultimo_criativo_source_url,
    p.metadata_json,
    p.total_mensagens,
    p.last_message_at,
    p.created_at,
    (
      SELECT ROUND(AVG(m.tempo_resposta_segundos))
      FROM mensagens m 
      WHERE m.loja_id = p.loja_id
        AND m.pessoa_id = p.id 
        AND m.direcao = 'inbound' 
        AND m.tempo_resposta_segundos IS NOT NULL
    ) AS tempo_medio_resposta_segundos,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*)::int 
      FROM mensagens m 
      WHERE m.pessoa_id = p.id AND m.is_ad = true
    ) AS total_mensagens_ad,
    (
      SELECT m.conteudo 
      FROM mensagens m 
      WHERE m.pessoa_id = p.id 
      ORDER BY m.created_at DESC 
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS ultima_mensagem,
    (
      SELECT m.tipo 
      FROM mensagens m 
      WHERE m.pessoa_id = p.id 
      ORDER BY m.created_at DESC 
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS ultimo_tipo_mensagem,
    (
      SELECT m.direcao 
      FROM mensagens m 
      WHERE m.pessoa_id = p.id 
      ORDER BY m.created_at DESC 
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS ultima_direcao
  FROM pessoas p
  JOIN lojas l ON l.id = p.loja_id
  LEFT JOIN criativos cr ON cr.id = p.ultimo_criativo_id
  WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND COALESCE((p.metadata_json->>'is_interno')::boolean, false) = false
    AND ($1::int IS NULL OR p.loja_id = $1::int)
    AND (
      $2::text = '' 
      OR p.nome ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%' 
      OR p.whatsapp ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
    )
    AND ($3::text = '' OR p.origem = $3::text)
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    (
      b.origem IN ('instagram_ads', 'facebook_ads', 'google_ads')
      OR COALESCE((b.metadata_json->>'isAd')::boolean, false) = true
    ) AS is_ad_lead,
    (
      b.origem IN ('instagram_ads', 'facebook_ads')
      OR (COALESCE((b.metadata_json->>'isAd')::boolean, false) = true AND COALESCE(b.metadata_json->>'canal', '') <> 'google')
    ) AS is_meta_ads,
    (
      b.origem = 'google_ads'
      OR b.ultimo_criativo_canal = 'google'
      OR COALESCE(b.metadata_json->>'canal', '') = 'google'
    ) AS is_google_ads,
    (b.ultima_direcao = 'inbound') AS is_sem_resposta,
    (
      (b.ultima_direcao = 'inbound' AND b.last_message_at IS NOT NULL AND b.last_message_at < (NOW() - interval '15 minutes'))
      OR COALESCE(b.tempo_medio_resposta_segundos, 0) > 900
    ) AS is_sla_estourado
  FROM base_filtered b
),
quick_filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM classified c
  WHERE (
    $4::text = 'todos'
    OR ($4::text = 'sem_resposta' AND c.is_sem_resposta)
    OR ($4::text = 'sla_estourado' AND c.is_sla_estourado)
    OR ($4::text = 'meta_ads' AND c.is_meta_ads)
    OR ($4::text = 'google_ads' AND c.is_google_ads)
  )
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int AS total_contatos,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_ad_lead)::int AS leads_ads,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_sem_resposta)::int AS sem_resposta,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_sla_estourado)::int AS sla_estourado
  FROM classified
),
filtered_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_filtrado FROM quick_filtered
),
paged AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM quick_filtered
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'nome' AND $8::text = 'asc' THEN LOWER(COALESCE(nome, '')) END ASC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'nome' AND $8::text = 'desc' THEN LOWER(COALESCE(nome, '')) END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'loja_nome' AND $8::text = 'asc' THEN LOWER(COALESCE(loja_nome, '')) END ASC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'loja_nome' AND $8::text = 'desc' THEN LOWER(COALESCE(loja_nome, '')) END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'origem' AND $8::text = 'asc' THEN LOWER(COALESCE(origem, '')) END ASC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'origem' AND $8::text = 'desc' THEN LOWER(COALESCE(origem, '')) END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'total_mensagens' AND $8::text = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(total_mensagens, 0) END ASC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'total_mensagens' AND $8::text = 'desc' THEN COALESCE(total_mensagens, 0) END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'tempo_medio_resposta_segundos' AND $8::text = 'asc' THEN tempo_medio_resposta_segundos END ASC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'tempo_medio_resposta_segundos' AND $8::text = 'desc' THEN tempo_medio_resposta_segundos END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN $7::text = 'last_message_at' AND $8::text = 'asc' THEN last_message_at END ASC NULLS LAST,
    last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT $5::int OFFSET $6::int
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'contatos', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(p) FROM paged p), '[]'::json),
  'resumo', json_build_object(
    'total_contatos', (SELECT total_contatos FROM summary),
    'leads_ads', (SELECT leads_ads FROM summary),
    'sem_resposta', (SELECT sem_resposta FROM summary),
    'sla_estourado', (SELECT sla_estourado FROM summary),
    'total_filtrado', (SELECT total_filtrado FROM filtered_count)
  )
) AS data;
